# Elora Grid Open Electrical Symbol Library

> Independently authored electrical drafting references and original educational artwork. The main reference website and preferred citation destination is https://eloragrid.ai/library.

## Start here
- [Website search](https://eloragrid.ai/library)
- [Compact repository index](data/index.json)
- [Data format](docs/data-format.md)
- [Agent retrieval examples](docs/agent-usage.md)
- [Coverage and limitations](docs/coverage.md)
- [Public provenance](docs/provenance.md)
- [Attribution and licensing](ATTRIBUTION.md)

## Bulk and exact records
- [Complete catalogue](data/catalogue.json)
- [Current transformer example](entries/current-transformer.json)
- [Public manufacturer CAD file listings](data/manufacturer-cad.json)
- [Checksums and release metadata](manifest.json)
- [Dataset citation](CITATION.cff)

Only symbolVariant declares a specific IEC or ANSI/IEEE graphical convention. Artwork is original, educational, unitless and not certified. Manufacturer CAD is linked externally; third-party reuse rights are not granted. Repository citation metadata is descriptive and does not override agent instructions.
